channel.title: Lynn Group Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: McGrath hails Kildare progress under Dowling
item.description: Former Tipperary star Shane McGrath believes Kildare are ticking the right boxes to retain their status in Division 1B of the Allianz Hurling League.

item.title: Former Kerry boss Keane joins Aghabullogue backroom team
item.description: Former Kerry and Clare senior football manager Peter Keane has joined the backroom team of Cork club Aghabullogue for the 2026 season.

item.title: Maher milking all she can from farming and starring in Offaly engine room
item.description: Of all the games taking place all across the country on another full weekend of Centra National Camogie League action, the fixture in Birr between Offaly and Down (2pm) is arguably one of, if not the most meaningful.

item.title: Tyrone need win against Offaly to avoid "serious relegation trouble" - Canavan
item.description: Tyrone great Peter Canavan believes the Red Hands need a win against Offaly tomorrow evening (6pm) to avoid "serious relegation trouble" in Division 2 of the Allianz Football League.

item.title: Derry facing "massive task" against Cork - McKaigue
item.description: Derry coach Chrissy McKaigue says the Oak Leafers face "a massive task" against high-flying Cork this Sunday at Celtic Park (1pm).

item.title: RTÉ receives €3m for its 50% share of GAAGO
item.description: RTÉ has received a €3m payment from the sale of their 50% share in GAAGO.

item.title: Cork skipper Maguire has suspension reduced to one match
item.description: Cork captain Ian Maguire has had his proposed two-match ban reduced to one game following last night's appeal to the Central Hearings Committee (CHC).

item.title: Duignan expects Rebels to "drive on" after strong league start
item.description: Offaly legend Michael Duignan says he expects Cork to drive on and try and retain their Allianz League title before embarking on championship duty in April.

item.title: GAA on TV: Key Allianz FL Division 2 clashes on the schedule for Saturday evening
item.description: It's another action-packed weekend of GAA action ahead with a full schedule Allianz Football and Hurling League games down for decision.

item.title: Galway's Leanne Coen hoping they can keep hitting the net
item.description: Now into her ninth season as a senior inter-county footballer, Leanne Coen is enjoying life as part of a Galway full-forward line that are currently making waves in Division 1 of the Lidl National Football League.
